Clean up nestbox numbers and locations so the breeding data can be matched to the coordinate file

```{r}
clean_location_code <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  x_upper <- str_to_upper(x)

  case_when(str_starts(x_upper, "BLD") | x_upper == "CU" ~ "BLD",
    str_detect(x_upper, "SUGARLOAF") | str_starts(x_upper, "SGR") | x_upper == "BLD/SGR" ~ "SGR",str_starts(x_upper, "NED") ~ "NED",str_starts(x_upper, "MRS") ~ "MRS",str_starts(x_upper, "FLG") ~ "FLG",TRUE ~ x_upper)
}

get_box_number <- function(x) {
  as.integer(str_extract(as.character(x), "\\d+"))
}

BS <- BS %>%
  mutate(Location = str_squish(as.character(Location)),
    Nestbox = str_squish(as.character(Nestbox)),Species = str_squish(as.character(Species)),Year = as.integer(Year),location_code_clean = clean_location_code(Location), box_number = get_box_number(Nestbox))

BSpop <- BSpop %>%
  mutate(Species = str_squish(as.character(Species)),
    Sex = str_squish(as.character(Sex)),ID = str_squish(as.character(ID)),
    Nestbox = str_squish(as.character(Nestbox)),
    Year = as.integer(Year))

nestbox_coords <- nestbox_coords %>%
  transmute(coordinate_location = str_squish(as.character(Location)),
    location_code_clean = clean_location_code(Location),
    box_number = as.integer(as.numeric(Box.number)),
    longitude = as.numeric(GPS.Longitude_E),
    latitude = as.numeric(GPS.Latitide_N)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(box_number), !is.na(longitude), !is.na(latitude)) %>%
  distinct(location_code_clean, box_number, .keep_all = TRUE)

map_points <- BS %>%
  left_join(nestbox_coords, by = c("location_code_clean", "box_number")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(longitude), !is.na(latitude))
```

Functions for the map background

```{r}
lonlat_to_tile <- function(lon, lat, zoom) {
  lat_rad <- lat * pi / 180
  n <- 2^zoom

  data.frame(x = floor((lon + 180) / 360 * n),
    y = floor((1 - log(tan(lat_rad) + 1 / cos(lat_rad)) / pi) / 2 * n))
}

tile_to_lonlat_bounds <- function(x, y, zoom) {
  n <- 2^zoom

  c(xmin = x / n * 360 - 180,
    xmax = (x + 1) / n * 360 - 180,
    ymin = atan(sinh(pi * (1 - 2 * (y + 1) / n))) * 180 / pi,
    ymax = atan(sinh(pi * (1 - 2 * y / n))) * 180 / pi)
}

read_map_tile <- function(tile_path) {
  tile <- try(readPNG(tile_path), silent = TRUE)

  if (inherits(tile, "try-error")) {
    tile <- try(readJPEG(tile_path), silent = TRUE)
  }

  if (length(dim(tile)) == 2) {
    tile <- array(rep(tile, 4), dim = c(dim(tile), 4))
    tile[, , 4] <- 1
  }

  if (length(dim(tile)) == 3 & dim(tile)[3] == 3) {
    tile <- array(
      c(tile, rep(1, dim(tile)[1] * dim(tile)[2])),
      dim = c(dim(tile)[1], dim(tile)[2], 4))
  }

  tile
}

get_shaded_relief_map <- function(bbox, zoom = 13) {
  cache_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "map_tiles")
  dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  northwest <- lonlat_to_tile(bbox["xmin"], bbox["ymax"], zoom)
  southeast <- lonlat_to_tile(bbox["xmax"], bbox["ymin"], zoom)

  x_tiles <- seq(northwest$x, southeast$x)
  y_tiles <- seq(northwest$y, southeast$y)
  tile_size <- 256

  map_image <- array(1, dim = c(tile_size * length(y_tiles),
                                tile_size * length(x_tiles),
                                4))

  for (ix in seq_along(x_tiles)) {
    for (iy in seq_along(y_tiles)) {
      x_tile <- x_tiles[ix]
      y_tile <- y_tiles[iy]

      tile_path <- file.path(cache_dir, paste("esri_shaded", zoom, x_tile, y_tile, "png", sep = "_"))
      tile_url <- sprintf("https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Shaded_Relief/MapServer/tile/%s/%s/%s",
        zoom, y_tile, x_tile)

      if (!file.exists(tile_path)) {
        download.file(tile_url, destfile = tile_path, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
      }

      tile <- read_map_tile(tile_path)
      row_index <- ((iy - 1) * tile_size + 1):(iy * tile_size)
      col_index <- ((ix - 1) * tile_size + 1):(ix * tile_size)
      map_image[row_index, col_index, ] <- tile
    }
  }

  west_north <- tile_to_lonlat_bounds(min(x_tiles), min(y_tiles), zoom)
  east_south <- tile_to_lonlat_bounds(max(x_tiles), max(y_tiles), zoom)

  list(image = map_image,xmin = west_north["xmin"],xmax = east_south["xmax"],
    ymin = east_south["ymin"],ymax = west_north["ymax"])
}
```

```{r}
make_year_palette <- function(years, species) {
  years <- sort(unique(years))

  if (species == "BCCH") {
    cols <- colorRampPalette(c("#66D9FF", "#009FE3", "#0060A8"))(length(years))
  }

  if (species == "MOCH") {
    cols <- colorRampPalette(c("#FF7AC1", "#EC2E90", "#B0005B"))(length(years))
  }

  names(cols) <- years
  cols
```

Plot female and male wing length within pairs

```{r}
make_sma_fit <- function(data) {
  data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(Female.Wing.Chord), !is.na(Male.Wing.Chord))
  r <- cor(data$Female.Wing.Chord, data$Male.Wing.Chord)
  #Standardized major axis slope for two measured morphological traits.
  slope <- sign(r) * sd(data$Male.Wing.Chord) / sd(data$Female.Wing.Chord)
  intercept <- mean(data$Male.Wing.Chord) - slope * mean(data$Female.Wing.Chord)
  x <- seq(min(data$Female.Wing.Chord), max(data$Female.Wing.Chord), length.out = 100)

  list(intercept = intercept,slope = slope,r2 = r^2,line = data.frame(Female.Wing.Chord = x, Male.Wing.Chord = intercept + slope * x))
}

make_sma_label <- function(data) {
  sma_fit <- make_sma_fit(data)

  paste0("\"SMA: \"*italic(y) == ",
         sprintf("%.2f", sma_fit$intercept),
         " + ",
         sprintf("%.2f", sma_fit$slope),
         " %.% italic(x)",
         "*','~~italic(R)^2 == ",
         sprintf("%.2f", sma_fit$r2))
}

mochLine <- ggplot(data = BSMOCH, aes(x = Female.Wing.Chord, y = Male.Wing.Chord)) +
```

# Reviewer comment: provide annual occupied nest counts by species

Make a supplemental table showing annual occupied nest counts for each species.

```{r}
annual_nest_counts <- BS %>%
  group_by(Year, Species) %>%
  summarise(occupied_nests = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species,
              values_from = occupied_nests,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = BCCH + MOCH) %>%
  arrange(Year)

annual_nest_counts_total <- annual_nest_counts %>%
  summarise(Year = "Total",
            BCCH = sum(BCCH),
            MOCH = sum(MOCH),
            Total = sum(Total))

annual_nest_counts_table <- bind_rows(annual_nest_counts %>% mutate(Year = as.character(Year)), annual_nest_counts_total)

annual_nest_counts_table

write.csv(annual_nest_counts_table,
          file.path(output_dir, "table_annual_occupied_nests_by_species.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# Reviewer comment: check multicollinearity in fixed effects

Check variance inflation factors for the fixed effects in the reproductive and parental-quality models.

```{r}
get_vif <- function(model_formula, data) {
  model_data <- model.frame(model_formula, data = data, na.action = na.omit)
  model_matrix <- model.matrix(model_formula, data = model_data)
  model_matrix <- model_matrix[, colnames(model_matrix) != "(Intercept)", drop = FALSE]

  if (ncol(model_matrix) == 1) {
    return(data.frame(term = colnames(model_matrix), vif = 1))
  }

  data.frame(term = colnames(model_matrix),vif = sapply(seq_len(ncol(model_matrix)), function(i) {
      predictor <- model_matrix[, i]
      other_predictors <- model_matrix[, -i, drop = FALSE]
      r_squared <- summary(lm(predictor ~ other_predictors))$r.squared
      1 / (1 - r_squared)
    }),row.names = NULL)
}

vif_table <- bind_rows(continuous_vif, category_vif) %>%
  mutate(vif = round(vif, 3)) %>%
  arrange(analysis, Species, response, term)

vif_summary <- vif_table %>%
  group_by(analysis) %>%
  summarise(max_vif = max(vif, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

vif_table
vif_summary

write.csv(vif_table,
          file.path(output_dir, "table_fixed_effect_vif_values.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# Reviewer comment: average nestling mass and brood size

Check whether including brood size improves models of average nestling mass.

```{r}
get_rmse <- function(model, data, response) {
  prediction <- predict(model, newdata = data, re.form = NA)
  sqrt(mean((data[[response]] - prediction)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

nestling_mass_data <- BS %>%
  filter(!is.na(Avg_Nestling_Weight),
         !is.na(Nestling_Number),
         !is.na(Wing_Difference),
         !is.na(Elevation),
         !is.na(Year))

nestling_mass_results <- bind_rows(lapply(c("BCCH", "MOCH"), function(sp) {
  species_data <- nestling_mass_data %>%
    filter(Species == sp)

  base_model <- lme4::lmer(Avg_Nestling_Weight ~ Wing_Difference + Elevation + (1|Year),data = species_data, REML = FALSE)

  brood_model <- lme4::lmer(Avg_Nestling_Weight ~ Wing_Difference + Nestling_Number + Elevation + (1|Year), data = species_data, REML = FALSE)

  interaction_model <- lme4::lmer(Avg_Nestling_Weight ~ Wing_Difference * Nestling_Number + Elevation + (1|Year),data = species_data, REML = FALSE)

  aic_values <- AIC(base_model, brood_model, interaction_model) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("model")

  wing_estimates <- bind_rows( data.frame(model = "base_model", wing_estimate = coef(summary(base_model))["Wing_Difference", "Estimate"]),
    data.frame(model = "brood_model", wing_estimate = coef(summary(brood_model))["Wing_Difference", "Estimate"]),
    data.frame(model = "interaction_model", wing_estimate = coef(summary(interaction_model))["Wing_Difference", "Estimate"]))

  data.frame( Species = sp, model = c("base_model", "brood_model", "interaction_model"), n = nrow(species_data),cor_mass_brood_size = cor(species_data$Avg_Nestling_Weight,species_data$Nestling_Number),AIC = aic_values$AIC, RMSE = c(get_rmse(base_model, species_data, "Avg_Nestling_Weight"),get_rmse(brood_model, species_data, "Avg_Nestling_Weight"),get_rmse(interaction_model, species_data, "Avg_Nestling_Weight"))) %>%
    left_join(wing_estimates, by = "model")
}))

nestling_mass_results

write.csv(nestling_mass_results,file.path(output_dir,"table_average_nestling_mass_brood_size_sensitivity.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
```

# Reviewer comment: year effects and repeated pairs

Run sensitivity analyses with year as a fixed effect, and then repeat those models after keeping one breeding attempt per social pair.

```{r}
get_lm_term <- function(model, term) {
  coef_table <- coef(summary(model))

  data.frame(estimate = coef_table[term, "Estimate"],
             SE = coef_table[term, "Std. Error"],
             test_statistic = coef_table[term, "t value"],
             p_value = coef_table[term, "Pr(>|t|)"])
}

get_tmb_term <- function(model, term) {
  coef_table <- coef(summary(model))$cond

  data.frame(estimate = coef_table[term, "Estimate"],
             SE = coef_table[term, "Std. Error"],
             test_statistic = coef_table[term, "z value"],
             p_value = coef_table[term, "Pr(>|z|)"])
}

run_fixed_year_model <- function(data, response, response_type, predictor,
                                 term, analysis_name) {
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[response]]),
           !is.na(.data[[predictor]]),
           !is.na(Elevation),
           !is.na(Year))

  if (predictor == "Wing_Difference_Category") {
    model_data <- model_data %>%
      filter(Wing_Difference_Category %in% c("Much", "Slightly")) %>%
      mutate(Wing_Difference_Category = factor(Wing_Difference_Category,
                                               levels = c("Much", "Slightly")))
  }

  fixed_year_formula <- as.formula(
    paste(response, "~", predictor, "+ Elevation + factor(Year)")
  )

  model_output <- lapply(c("BCCH", "MOCH"), function(sp) {
    species_data <- model_data %>%
      filter(Species == sp)

    if (nrow(species_data) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    if (response_type == "count") {
      model <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(fixed_year_formula, data = species_data,family = glmmTMB::compois)
      term_results <- get_tmb_term(model, term)
    } else {
      model <- lm(fixed_year_formula, data = species_data)
      term_results <- get_lm_term(model, term)
    }

    data.frame(analysis = analysis_name, response = response, Species = sp, n = nrow(species_data), term = term, term_results)
  })

  bind_rows(model_output)
}

response_models <- data.frame(
  response = c("First.Egg",
               "Egg_Number",
               "Nestling_Number",
               "Avg_Nestling_Weight",
               "Female_SMI",
               "Male_SMI",
               "Provisioning"),
  response_label = c("date of first egg",
                     "clutch size",
                     "brood size",
                     "average nestling mass",
                     "female SMI",
                     "male SMI",
                     "provisioning rate"),
  response_type = c("gaussian",
                    "count",
                    "count",
                    "gaussian",
                    "gaussian",
                    "gaussian",
                    "gaussian")
)

fixed_year_numeric <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(response_models)), function(i) {
  run_fixed_year_model(BS,response = response_models$response[i], response_type = response_models$response_type[i], predictor = "Wing_Difference",term = "Wing_Difference", analysis_name = "fixed_year_numeric")
})) %>%
  left_join(response_models, by = "response")

fixed_year_category <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(response_models)), function(i) {
  run_fixed_year_model(BS,response = response_models$response[i], response_type = response_models$response_type[i], predictor = "Wing_Difference_Category", term = "Wing_Difference_CategorySlightly", analysis_name = "fixed_year_category")
})) %>%
  left_join(response_models, by = "response")

BS_one_pair <- BS %>%
  arrange(Pair.ID, Year) %>%
  group_by(Pair.ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

fixed_year_one_pair_numeric <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(response_models)), function(i) {

                       response = response_models$response[i],
                       response_type = response_models$response_type[i],
                       predictor = "Wing_Difference",

                       analysis_name = "fixed_year_numeric_one_pair")
})) %>%
  left_join(response_models, by = "response")

fixed_year_one_pair_category <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(response_models)), function(i) {
  run_fixed_year_model(BS_one_pair,

})) %>%

year_pair_sensitivity <- bind_rows(fixed_year_numeric,
```

# Reviewer comment: test species differences directly

Run combined models with species, male-minus-female wing length, and their interaction to test whether the relationship between wing length difference and reproductive or parental-quality traits differs between species.

```{r}
get_species_interaction_lm <- function(model) {
  coef_table <- coef(summary(model))
  term <- "Wing_Difference:SpeciesMOCH"

  data.frame(estimate = coef_table[term, "Estimate"],
             SE = coef_table[term, "Std. Error"],
             test_statistic = coef_table[term, "t value"],
             p_value = coef_table[term, "Pr(>|t|)"])
}

get_species_interaction_tmb <- function(model) {
  coef_table <- coef(summary(model))$cond
  term <- "Wing_Difference:SpeciesMOCH"

  data.frame(estimate = coef_table[term, "Estimate"],
             SE = coef_table[term, "Std. Error"],
             test_statistic = coef_table[term, "z value"],
             p_value = coef_table[term, "Pr(>|z|)"])
}

run_species_interaction_model <- function(data, response, response_type) {
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[response]]),
           !is.na(Wing_Difference),
           !is.na(Species),
           !is.na(Elevation),
           !is.na(Year)) %>%
    mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = c("BCCH", "MOCH")))

  model_formula <- as.formula(
    paste(response, "~ Wing_Difference * Species + Elevation + factor(Year)")
  )

  if (response_type == "count") {
    model <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(model_formula,
                              data = model_data,
                              family = glmmTMB::compois)
    term_results <- get_species_interaction_tmb(model)
  } else {
    model <- lm(model_formula, data = model_data)
    term_results <- get_species_interaction_lm(model)
  }

  species_slopes <- bind_rows(lapply(c("BCCH", "MOCH"), function(sp) {
    species_data <- model_data %>%
      filter(Species == sp)

    species_formula <- as.formula( paste(response, "~ Wing_Difference + Elevation + factor(Year)"))

    if (response_type == "count") {
      species_model <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(species_formula,
                                        data = species_data,
                                        family = glmmTMB::compois)
      coef_table <- coef(summary(species_model))$cond
      slope <- data.frame(estimate = coef_table["Wing_Difference", "Estimate"],
                          SE = coef_table["Wing_Difference", "Std. Error"],
                          p_value = coef_table["Wing_Difference", "Pr(>|z|)"])
    } else {
      species_model <- lm(species_formula, data = species_data)
      coef_table <- coef(summary(species_model))
      slope <- data.frame(estimate = coef_table["Wing_Difference", "Estimate"],
                          SE = coef_table["Wing_Difference", "Std. Error"],
                          p_value = coef_table["Wing_Difference", "Pr(>|t|)"])
    }

    data.frame(Species = sp,n = nrow(species_data), slope_estimate = slope$estimate,slope_SE = slope$SE,
               slope_p_value = slope$p_value)
  }))

  data.frame(response = response,
             n_total = nrow(model_data),
             interaction_term = "Wing_Difference:SpeciesMOCH",
             interaction_estimate = term_results$estimate,
             interaction_SE = term_results$SE,
             interaction_test_statistic = term_results$test_statistic,
             interaction_p_value = term_results$p_value) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(species_slopes)
}

species_interaction_results <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(response_models)), function(i) {
  run_species_interaction_model(BS,
                                response = response_models$response[i],
                                response_type = response_models$response_type[i])
})) %>%
  left_join(response_models, by = "response") %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  mutate(slope_p_adjusted_BH = p.adjust(slope_p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(interaction_p_adjusted_BH = p.adjust(interaction_p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  select(response_label, response,  n_total, Species,  n, slope_estimate, slope_SE, slope_p_value,  slope_p_adjusted_BH,interaction_term,interaction_estimate, interaction_SE, interaction_test_statistic,interaction_p_value,interaction_p_adjusted_BH) %>%
  arrange(response_label, Species)

species_interaction_summary <- species_interaction_results %>%
  distinct(response_label,
           response,
           n_total,
           interaction_estimate,
           interaction_SE,
           interaction_test_statistic,
           interaction_p_value,
           interaction_p_adjusted_BH) %>%
  arrange(interaction_p_value)

species_interaction_results
species_interaction_summary

write.csv(species_interaction_results,
          file.path(output_dir, "table_species_interaction_models.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(species_interaction_summary,
          file.path(output_dir, "table_species_interaction_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# Reviewer comment: model diagnostics for final reproductive models

Check diagnostics for the final combined species-by-wing-difference models.

```{r}
get_model_diagnostics <- function(data, response, response_type) {
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[response]]),
           !is.na(Wing_Difference),
           !is.na(Species),
           !is.na(Elevation),
           !is.na(Year)) %>%
    mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = c("BCCH", "MOCH")))

  model_formula <- as.formula(paste(response, "~ Wing_Difference * Species + Elevation + factor(Year)"))

  if (response_type == "count") {
    model <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(model_formula,
                              data = model_data,
                              family = glmmTMB::compois)
    residuals_sim <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(model, plot = FALSE)

    data.frame(n = nrow(model_data), convergence = model$fit$convergence,
               positive_definite_hessian = model$sdr$pdHess,
               uniformity_p = DHARMa::testUniformity(residuals_sim,
                                                     plot = FALSE)$p.value,
               dispersion_p = DHARMa::testDispersion(residuals_sim,
                                                     plot = FALSE)$p.value,
               outlier_p = DHARMa::testOutliers(residuals_sim,
                                                plot = FALSE)$p.value)
  } else {
    model <- lm(model_formula, data = model_data)

    data.frame(n = nrow(model_data), convergence = NA, positive_definite_hessian = NA, uniformity_p = NA, dispersion_p = NA, outlier_p = NA)
  }
}

final_model_diagnostics <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(response_models)), function(i) {
  get_model_diagnostics(BS, response = response_models$response[i], response_type = response_models$response_type[i]) %>%
    mutate(response = response_models$response[i],
           response_label = response_models$response_label[i],
           response_type = response_models$response_type[i])
})) %>%
  select(response_label, response, response_type, n, convergence, positive_definite_hessian, uniformity_p, dispersion_p, outlier_p)

final_model_diagnostics

write.csv(final_model_diagnostics, file.path(output_dir, "table_final_model_diagnostics.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
```

# Reviewer comment: revise Figure 3

Remake Figure 3 using the combined species-by-wing-difference models. Confidence intervals are shown with lines instead of shaded ribbons.

```{r}
figure3_responses <- data.frame(
  response = c("First.Egg", "Egg_Number", "Nestling_Number", "Avg_Nestling_Weight", "Female_SMI","Male_SMI", "Provisioning"),
  response_label = c("Date of first egg", "Clutch size","Brood size", "Avg. nestling mass (g)","Female SMI", "Male SMI","Provisioning rate"),
  response_type = c("gaussian", "count","count", "gaussian", "gaussian", "gaussian","gaussian"))

species_colors <- c("BCCH" = "#0072B2",
                    "MOCH" = "#CC79A7")

get_common_year <- function(data) {
  names(sort(table(data$Year), decreasing = TRUE))[1] %>%
    as.numeric()
}

make_prediction_data <- function(data, response) {
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[response]]),
           !is.na(Wing_Difference),
           !is.na(Species),
           !is.na(Elevation),
           !is.na(Year)) %>%
    mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = c("BCCH", "MOCH")))

  pred_grid <- expand_grid(
    Wing_Difference = seq(min(model_data$Wing_Difference, na.rm = TRUE),
                          max(model_data$Wing_Difference, na.rm = TRUE),
                          length.out = 100),
    Species = factor(c("BCCH", "MOCH"), levels = c("BCCH", "MOCH"))) %>%
    mutate(Elevation = median(model_data$Elevation, na.rm = TRUE),
           Year = get_common_year(model_data))

  list(model_data = model_data,
       pred_grid = pred_grid)
}

fit_interaction_model_for_plot <- function(model_data, response, response_type) {
  model_formula <- as.formula(paste(response, "~ Wing_Difference * Species + Elevation + factor(Year)"))

  if (response_type == "count") {
    glmmTMB::glmmTMB(model_formula,
                     data = model_data,
                     family = glmmTMB::compois)
  } else {
    lm(model_formula, data = model_data)
  }
}

predict_interaction_model <- function(model, pred_grid, response_type) {
  if (response_type == "count") {
    pred <- predict(model, newdata = pred_grid,  type = "link", se.fit = TRUE)

    pred_grid %>%
      mutate(predicted = exp(pred$fit),
             conf.low = exp(pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit),
             conf.high = exp(pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit))
  } else {
    pred <- predict(model,
                    newdata = pred_grid,
                    se.fit = TRUE)

    pred_grid %>%
      mutate(predicted = pred$fit,
             conf.low = pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit,
             conf.high = pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit)
  }
}

make_figure3_panel <- function(data, response, response_label, response_type) {
  plot_data <- make_prediction_data(data, response)
  model <- fit_interaction_model_for_plot(plot_data$model_data,
                                          response,
                                          response_type)
  predictions <- predict_interaction_model(model,
                                           plot_data$pred_grid,
                                           response_type)

  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = plot_data$model_data,
               aes(x = Wing_Difference,
                   y = .data[[response]],
                   fill = Species),
               shape = 21,
               color = "black",
               stroke = 0.25,
               size = 1.4,
               alpha = 0.55,
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0)) +
    geom_line(data = predictions,
              aes(x = Wing_Difference,
                  y = predicted,
                  color = Species),
              linewidth = 0.85) +
    geom_line(data = predictions,
              aes(x = Wing_Difference,
                  y = conf.low,
                  color = Species),
              linewidth = 0.35,
              linetype = "dashed",
              alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_line(data = predictions,
              aes(x = Wing_Difference,
                  y = conf.high,
                  color = Species),
              linewidth = 0.35,
              linetype = "dashed",
              alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = species_colors) +
    labs(x = "Male-minus-female wing length (mm)",
         y = response_label) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
          plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4))
}

figure3_panels <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(figure3_responses)), function(i) {
```
